scope: Corollary 14.3 (The additional root cyclic) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 98. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the root case in which no power of the root cyclic group is claimed by the object system, its maximal cyclic overgroup may be added to the peripheral family. Its nontrivial incidences have finite orbit lists, and the relative embeddings and finite-path conclusions continue to hold with the enlarged induced systems.
